name: Virox
description: The Virox is a terrifying monstrosity, distinguished by its double-jawed maw and ability to assault prey with powerful psychic attacks. Its regenerative abilities make it extremely difficult to bring down, let alone kill. A Virox will continue to regenerate, mending wounds rapidly, unless its head is fully separated from its body.

actions.name: Ravaging Claws
actions.description: The virox makes an attack with with it's menacing claws, dealing physical damage. This attack deals additional 1d8 psychic damage to creatures marked by the Shriek action.

actions.name: Shriek
actions.description: The virox lets loose a piercing shriek, marking targets that are affected for the next minute. This mark adds additional effects to the virox's other actions.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: The virox bites a creature, dealing physical damage. Creatures who are marked that reach 0 health as a result of this ability fall unconscious with 8 lifeline points plus their resilience bonus modifier.

actions.name: Cross Bite
actions.description: Immediately after dealing damage with the Bite action, the virox bites again with it's horizontal jaw, dealing physical damage. The affected creature must make a resilience check greater than the damage done or gain the bleeding condition.

actions.name: Mind Pierce
actions.description: The virox targets an unconscious creature within 6 units and pierces their mind, dealing psychic damage directly to their lifeline. A creature with 4 or more psychic mitigation cannot be affected by this damage.

actions.name: Protective Shell
actions.description: At the end of it's turn, the virox curls into a ball to protect itself. The creature must make a resilience check to determine its bonus mitigation while protected in this way. This ability lasts until it is willfully ended or the virox takes damage after calculating mitigations. This reaction can only be used once per engagement.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: If the virox does not take damage for an entire round, it gains 2d12 health back at the start of it's turn.

traits.name: Psychic Reflection
traits.description: When the virox takes psychic damage, it deals half of the total damage taken after mitigation back to the source if that source is a creature within 6 units.
